Defining this exclusive programme is a suite of tailored services, privileges, and pricing benefits, including:

A dedicated Senior Relationship Manager

Get personalized services and bespoke solutions from your Relationship Manager & Wealth Advisor who are experts in local, regional, and global markets

Our core Wealth Management offerings

include investment advisory services, trade execution services including access to our in-house derivative trading system, Lombard lending (credit solutions against assets), offshore booking centers and trust & estate planning

Efficiently and promptly executed Foreign Exchange solutions

closely aligned with your needs, from remitting funds home in real time or saving in other currencies to a travel card that holds up to 15 currencies, or even investing in currency-linked options

Business and leisure travel itinerary management
Priority reservations at restaurants around the world
Dedicated personal shopping and fashion experts
On-demand charter hire and rental
Seamless execution of day-to-day tasks
Seasoned event planners to conceptualise and deliver events

Visa Infinite Debit Card

Superior benefits and outstanding lifestyle-enriching benefits

Complimentary membership to Quintessentially

  • An expert, resourceful Global Concierge Team responsive at all hours to your daily and occasional tasks or needs.
  • From securing bookings at Michelin-starred restaurants or assisting with a last-minute travel itinerary, shopping and gifting to booking charters and rentals or organising access to events and hospitality.

Dining

  • Receive up to 30% off at over 2,000 restaurants in Emirates NBD’s exclusive Bon Appétit program.
  • Take advantage of exciting 2-for-1 Entertainer offers through the Entertainer Xperience App.
  • Enjoy exclusive dining discounts at over 200 airport restaurants via the DragonPass Dine & Travel App.

VIP Valet Parking, F&B Discounts and much more

  • Enjoy the convenience of VIP Valet Parking thrice a month at Dubai Airports, The Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates and at select locations in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain.
  • Up to 30% discount on Food and Beverages.

Travel

  • Get unlimited LoungeKey visits for the cardholder and a guest at over 1000 premier airport lounges.
  • Benefit from up to 35% off AVIS car rentals worldwide.
  • Be reassured by complimentary travel insurance of up to USD 500,000 cover on travel delays, baggage delays, medical expenses and more.

Hotels

  • Secure the Best Available Rate, complimentary breakfast daily, F&B credit and more at over 900 Visa Luxury Collection hotels.
  • Enjoy exclusive discounts on Booking.com
  • Savour up to 25% off bookings at select Jumeirah hotels.
  • Save with bookings on Agoda.

Lifestyle and Shopping

  • Enjoy up to 50% off with LiveWell at over 500 spas, medical and wellness centres, gyms, and salons.
  • Get complimentary access to some of the best golf courses in the UAE.
  • Revel in up to 50% off across theme parks, indoor sports, marine attractions, exciting adventures and more.
  • Receive exclusive golf discounts on green fees at golf clubs across the UAE and globally.
  • Extend your product warranty up to one additional year on purchases made with your card.

Live your success.

We believe that success is a journey, not a destination. Our Signature by Priority Banking Team is proud to be a part of this journey with you.
